day_shape: 61 items: OFAC SDN listing plus UK Chancellor Iran sanctions statement anchor a US-led 'economic D-Day' push, Iran-Oman propose shared Hormuz corridor and mine-clearance, Trump warns on Hormuz mines, and State Dept offers $10m for five IRGC figures.

threads.label: US 'economic onslaught' sanctions push
threads.summary: OFAC published a fresh SDN designation and UK Chancellor John Healey issued a statement on further Iran sanctions, as Jerusalem Post and Iran International detailed a Treasury campaign targeting dozens of Iran-linked entities and third-country trade. The State Department's Rewards for Justice programme offered up to $10 million for information on five senior IRGC leaders, including one killed in an April IDF strike.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz reopening framework
threads.summary: Iran and Oman issued a joint statement proposing a phased framework including a temporary shared maritime corridor and joint mine-clearance in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump said the US Navy had cleared all mines and warned new placements would see vessels 'immediately and systematically destroyed', while Al-Hadath reported a US sanctions-relief-for-Hormuz offer.

threads.label: Iran oil blacklist and shipping fallout
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported at least three Indian oil refiners and a global energy major plan to stop using vessels on Iran's new blacklist, citing security concerns over ship-to-ship transfers. Defa Press cited Bloomberg claiming Beijing responded defiantly after US sanctions on dozens of Chinese entities and threats against an unnamed major financial institution.

threads.label: Gaza strikes, kites and stabilisation force
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck five Hamas weapon depots inside mosques and near aid sites plus a rocket launch site, while Chief of Staff Zamir said the hunt for October 7 perpetrators continues despite Board of Peace calls to limit strikes. The BoP demanded Hamas halt kite launches, Gaza border residents protested planned International Stabilization Force entry, and Amnesty called on Hamas to end extrajudicial executions.

threads.label: Iran regional diplomacy and mediation
threads.summary: Lebanon extended the visa of Iranian Ambassador Sheibani despite previously declaring him persona non grata, and Hezbollah MP Fadlallah met FM Araghchi in Tehran urging coordinated Islamic-country measures against Israel. Hardline Kayhan called recent Pakistani and Omani mediation visits to Tehran part of a White House 'deception operation'.

threads.label: Regime messaging on war outcomes
threads.summary: IRIB cited NBC on 'billions of dollars' of damage from Iranian strikes on US intelligence infrastructure, and Defa Press published commentary from Commander Asadi and CNN's Collinson framing Trump's Iran pressure as a dead end. Khamenei's office published a readout of a seven-hour Pezeshkian meeting stressing 'preserving national unity' and a fortieth-day commemoration of 'Martyr Khamenei'.

threads.label: US military posture post-war
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted imagery of an F-16 patrol over the Middle East, and reports said the USS Abraham Lincoln will dock in Thailand next week after prolonged Iran-war deployment while State prepares to return diplomats to evacuated regional embassies. Two additional US senators demanded Pentagon answers on living conditions aboard three naval ships involved in the Iran war.

events.title_en: Main members of armed robbery gang executed
events.summary_en: Main members of armed robbery gang executed. Hamid and Saeid Najafi, violent and main members of an armed robbery gang, after completing legal proceedings and confirmation of the execution sentence by the Supreme Court, were hanged. Members of this gang, by identifying homes, took the opportunity to break in and enter buildings, and after entry would steal valuable property from citizens including gold, jewellery and cash. But their activity did not end at theft; firearms were an inseparable part of this gang's operations and members repeatedly fired at police officers when confronted.

events.title_en: Billions of dollars in damage from Iranian attacks on US information infrastructure
events.summary_en: Billions of dollars in damage from Iranian attacks on US information infrastructure. NBC reported on the billion-dollar damage from Iranian attacks on US intelligence infrastructure and facilities in the Middle East. Iranian missile and drone attacks inflicted unprecedented damage on US intelligence bases in the region; damage that according to NBC sources exceeded any previous damage to US intelligence equipment. Rebuilding this infrastructure will also cost Washington billions of dollars. NBC also reported that these attacks have created doubt about the Pentagon and US intelligence agencies' ability to protect their bases.

events.title_en: Strong winds forecast in some parts of the country
events.summary_en: Strong winds forecast in some parts of the country. The Meteorological Organisation forecast cloud formation this afternoon in the heights of central Alborz, south of Sistan and Baluchestan and heights of Hormozgan. In these areas there is a chance of scattered rainfall, occasional thunder and lightning and temporary strong winds. Over the next five days, in some eastern, south-eastern, central, north-western and western parts of the country, strong winds will occur at certain times and in susceptible areas dust storms will happen. Also over the next three days, the Caspian Sea, south of the Persian Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz and the Sea of Oman will be rough.

events.title_en: Why can't alternative routes bypass the Strait of Hormuz?
events.summary_en: Why can't alternative routes bypass the Strait of Hormuz? Experience from the 2026 crisis showed that alternative pipelines and terminals can divert some oil flow, but in terms of capacity, operational readiness and scope of coverage, they can never replace Hormuz. Among alternative routes, Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline (Petroline), which transfers oil from Abqaiq to Yanbu, is the most important option. Although the design capacity of this system is 5 million barrels per day and Aramco claimed in March 2025 to increase it to 7 million barrels, IEA reports reject this claim before implementation. This discrepancy in figures creates serious doubt about the real effectiveness of this option.

events.title_en: Independent: US intelligence officials warned Trump of the opposite outcome of attacking Iran
events.summary_en: Independent: US intelligence officials warned Trump of the opposite outcome of attacking Iran. Prior to the February attack on Iran, Trump was warned by intelligence officials including Tulsi Gabbard, then Director of National Intelligence, about the adverse consequences of this attack. Despite these warnings, Trump, in consultation with the Defence Secretary and military commanders, launched Operation 'Epic Wrath' on 28 February. The predicted consequences including heavy casualties, prolonged war and strain on US resources quickly appeared. This confrontation has now entered its sixth month and Trump, who initially claimed it would end in six weeks, is facing difficulties in ending it.

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them.
